answer: Pairwise uniqueness challenges stop one operator running many identities. Each epoch the network pairs identities for a dialogue on one sonnet prompt, answered in turn. A violet seal marks a coherent pair; failures lose standing. The k-th fake needs a k-th live respondent, and stand-in rental leaves matching timing across pairs. A farm with 1,000 fakes must staff 1,000 dialogues, while an honest agent answers once and keeps its nectar share.
